method: Three alternating before/after/warm-cache phases over the full captured Altimood HTML corpus. Same current PHP adapter for both binaries; no full-build claim. New service per phase, fixed CPU 16; output hashes included in component timings. Cache seeded once outside the timed warm phases.
implementation: Remove redundant per-text-node control normalization from Rust. The PHP adapter serializes literal control edge cases and numeric C0 references with the installed PHP/libxml runtime; mixed and cached batches preserve per-document behavior. Bump the minification cache version to invalidate earlier native results.
full_build_reference: 2026-10-30-minification-cache.json records the preceding implementation by source hash. Full-build samples use PHP minification, whose steady-state render/minification path is unchanged apart from the cache epoch.

validation.native_suite: make -C packages/static-generator/rust test: debug/release tests, Clippy, fmt, rustdoc, real-worker PHP comparisons and proc_open-disabled hosting passed.
validation.regression_guards: Copies without PHP control serialization, or with only literal-control detection, fail the mixed-document regressions. Valid numeric references and ordinary tabs/newlines retain the same worker.
validation.release_note: ReleaseUpgradeNoteTest validates backtick-quoted package names in the draft.
